title: The Shrine of Trials
text: Before a shrine to the Six sits a basin of coals glowing red, though no one feeds it. The devout may walk the coals and be blessed, the sign says; anyone else is burned. Cinders that look like toes are scattered on the stones around the basin.

options.label: The most devout walks the coals, trusting the Six to know them.

outcomes.text: They cross without a blister. The Six are pleased.
The Six are not so sure.

options.label: Pray before the shrine and leave the coals to the faithful.

outcomes.text: The coals glow kindly, warming you through.

options.label: Douse the coals and take the basin; no god needs brass.

outcomes.text: The brass is heavy and very old. The coals hiss as they die.
